race.description: Pacific Fair Magic Millions Polo & Showjumping Mdn Plate
race.comment: TENNESSEE RIVER (9) has not appeared since a cracking debut in the Listed Woodlands Stakes over 1100m here in May, coming from a long way back to get up for fourth. Trialling well and looks to have come on over the break. Huge chance to open the account in this far easier assignment. THE WILDLING (10) closed well but never looked likely last start over 1300m at Canberra. Comes back in trip which doesn't look ideal but in a race of few chances she should be competitive with the help of gate one. HALCYON BELLE (6) is back after a 23-week spell. Has raced just once and did a fair job to finish fourth over 1100m at this circuit. Last trialled on 10 September and hasn't been sighted since. Keep an eye on the betting. FROG ROCK (3) overcame early interference to flash home and just miss when resuming over this distance at Muswellbrook recently. Can race handy from the good draw and looks a solid each-way hope. Market watch on SHASORT (7) on debut for the Archibald stable.
